name: singleron_gexscope
description: Singleron GEXSCOPE/SCOPE-chip droplet UMI data. Public FASTQs can appear as long paired-end reads and require Singleron-specific barcode/UMI extraction plus poly-A/adapter handling before STAR/STARsolo-compatible mapping.
notes: UniScFlow detects Singleron/GEXSCOPE/SCOPE-chip metadata and intentionally halts after download until a validated Singleron preprocessing path is provided.

halt_guidance.blocker: Singleron GEXSCOPE/SCOPE-chip processing requires kit-specific barcode extraction, whitelist correction, and poly-A/adapter handling before alignment.
required_inputs: Singleron kit/chemistry version and matching barcode configuration
CeleScope-compatible reference and any sample-specific library configuration
next_steps: Confirm the Singleron kit and chemistry version from methods or depositor metadata.
Run CeleScope with the matching chemistry, barcode resources, and reference.
Archive the CeleScope command/configuration and validate its feature-barcode matrix.

recommended_workflows.name: CeleScope
recommended_workflows.role: Singleron-oriented barcode processing, alignment, and quantification

halt_guidance.resume: Use the validated CeleScope matrix downstream; UniScFlow does not replace the kit-specific barcode extraction with generic STARsolo settings.
